about: Changes to a running site's schema (docs/spec/spec.md §2.10), each with the verdict the compiler and the runtime must both give. The compiler reads a case as tp/_generated/runtime-schema.json of the project in base/ (src/runtime_schema.rs); the runtime reads it as an addField change on a site that runs that build (tests/php/runtimeschema_test.php). `compiler` and `runtime` are "accept" or the code of the refusal: a compiler diagnostic code when both refuse, a problem code where only the running site does. `stored` is the definition both sides must end up with. `kinds` are whole collections and globals added the same way (`name_` is the new kind's name).
